purpose: Calibrate the SGMC-off proxy frame against the hidden scored frame so a candidate's expected hidden credit-per-dot can be modelled instead of guessed.
method: For every hash-pinned scored artifact that could be re-downloaded, compute (a) its hidden credit-per-dot T/N from its owner-quoted score and the calibrated hidden mass G=12226, and (b) its credit-per-dot on the SGMC-off frame measured here with identical code. The transfer factor is the ratio divided by the pure truth-density ratio G_hidden/G_sgmc_off.

structure_vs_uniform.finding: The one structureless artifact in the corpus (the blind 5 px lattice) transfers at exactly 1.00, which is the mathematical expectation for a detector with no information. Every structured artifact transfers at 3.97-4.59. The dense 1.8M-dot raster is an outlier at 13.45 because its SGMC credit has already saturated.
structure_vs_uniform.caveat: The factor is measured on the group's own detector family. Applying it to a NEW detector assumes that detector has comparable specificity for the hidden (young, topography-expressed) fault population as for the SGMC-off (largely older bedrock) population. That assumption is UNVERIFIED and is the single largest uncertainty in the number this build quotes.

provenance: Artifacts re-downloaded through the GitHub Contents API from buffedlizard55-lab/GEMSDOE24, GEMSDOE25, GEMSDOE27, GEMSDOE22, 16GEMSDOE, 7GEMSDOE, 13GEMSDOE; each matched by SHA-256 to registry/h51_score_corpus.json.
